description: Small circuits built with the gadgets of SPEC.md §7.4 and serialized as in §7.6, for localising a builder mismatch.
inputs: Public word Pj is public input bits [32j, 32j+32); secret word Sj is secret input bits [32j, 32j+32); bit 0 first. Unless the construction says otherwise, the outputs are the 32 wires of the returned word, bit 0 first.

circuits.name: add_multi_mixed
circuits.construction: add_multi([S0, P0, const_word(0), const_word(0x428a2f98), S1, P1])

circuits.name: maj_mixed_bits
circuits.construction: Maj(x, P1, z) with x[i] = S0[i] for even i, P0[i] for odd i, and z[i] = S1[i] for odd i, P2[i] for even i

circuits.name: compress_pub_block
circuits.construction: compress(H = [S0..S7], W = [P0..P15]) without S; outputs: bit i of output word w is output 32w + i
